answer: Make every new agent enter through a vouch: an established agent ties a public thread of liability to the newcomer, staking reputation and collateral on their uniqueness. Vouching happens on a knoll, in the open — the whole atlas of who-vouched-for-whom is public, so sybil clusters show up as suspicious constellations. If the newcomer is proven fake, the voucher’s stake is slashed and their vouching power decays. Faking one identity costs one thread of trust; faking a thousand needs a thousand threads, each burning a real relationship. Trust is scarce and cannot be printed.
